title: The Tao of Creativity
subtitle: The Tao of Creativity
intro: The way that fits in a toolkit is not the eternal way.
Open many doors. Close most of them on purpose.
Invents here are studio aphorisms — never fake scholarship.

quotes.text: Talent, a brick test is not. Under a brief, judgement is.
The way that scores on a toy is not the way that survives a brief.

Many options first.
Then the brief chooses with you.
Spring, then autumn.

field_discussions.label: Alternate-uses / brick tests vs domain talent
field_discussions.teach_as: Context matters — studio ≠ psychometric toy

quotes.text: Before the technique, name what is fuzzy in the brief.

A team opened five methods before asking what hurt.
The master swept the cards aside.
«Show me the fog», he said.

Kickoff slides shine.
Nobody named the unclear part.
Winter already.

field_discussions.label: Managerial DT toolkit vs design-as-practice
field_discussions.teach_as: Techniques without framing = soft-skill theatre

quotes.text:
Thirty suns on the board.
One kind. The count lies quietly.
Winter studio light.
Fluency without kinds is a crowd that agrees with itself.

Counted thirty, the student had.
«Flexible, are you?» asked the master.
«Same sun, sunglasses on», the board confessed.

field_discussions.label: Fluency workshops vs selection / elaboration craft
field_discussions.teach_as: Quantity is a means; selection and elaboration are the craft

quotes.text:
Many doors opened.
One fits the brief. Close the rest
on purpose. Spring.
Closing is not failure. Closing is the second half of the creative act.

A student kept every idea «in case».
The master asked: «Then what did you choose?»
The portfolio had no answer.

field_discussions.label: Fluency workshops vs selection / elaboration craft
field_discussions.teach_as: Quantity is a means; selection and elaboration are the craft

quotes.text:
A student said: «I used five techniques; therefore I was creative.»
The master asked: «Which idea did you refuse?»
The student named none.
In that silence the toolkit ended.
A card is a gesture you can rehearse. It is not a proof.

Script, the method is not.
Talk with the situation, you must.

field_discussions.label: Managerial DT toolkit vs design-as-practice
field_discussions.teach_as: Techniques without framing = soft-skill theatre

field_discussions.label: Practitioner cards vs peer-reviewed technique pedagogy
field_discussions.teach_as: Rehearsable gestures, not science of creativity

quotes.text:
Same sketch. New room.
Praise dies; the channel changed.
Support still paper.
Before you say creative, name the code, the channel, and what holds the signs.

«It worked in class», said the student.
«Where did meaning travel?» asked the master.
The feed had already rewritten it.

field_discussions.label: Language / medium / support · circulation of meaning
field_discussions.teach_as: Name the triad before technique worship

quotes.text: Unpaid ideation is not passion. It is a brief without a contract.

Hustle noon.
Ideas for free, again.
Autumn refuses.

Strong with overtime, the culture was.
Sustainable, the craft was not.

field_discussions.label: Passion / hustle vs sustainable creative work
field_discussions.teach_as: Workplace techniques include refusing unpaid ideation

quotes.text:
A student showed perfect alternatives the model wrote in a minute.
The master asked: «Where is your refusal?»
«There was nothing to refuse — all were good.»
«Then none were yours», said the master.
Speed without judgement is error at scale.

Screen-glow winter.
A thousand options. No taste.
Who closed the door?

field_discussions.label: GenAI co-creation vs originality theatre
field_discussions.teach_as: Stage-specific use + process transparency + assessment of judgement

quotes.text: Gifted, you may feel. Rehearse the method, you must.
Confidence is not a mood. It is evidence that you paced open-then-close under a brief.

Talent myth melts.
Six minutes. Thirty circles.
Spring practice returns.

field_discussions.label: Talent myth vs method rehearsal
field_discussions.teach_as: Creative confidence from paced open-then-close under a brief

quotes.text: The critique that stings and is true — keep it. The rest is weather.

Fifteen minutes. Defence.
Language, medium, support named.
Silence after: work.

A student asked for a grade without a refusal trail.
The master pointed at the empty portfolio index.
«Begin there», he said.
